Callout.Name: Domestic Disturbance - County
Callout.Message: Domestic disturbance reported at a rural address.
Callout.Advisory: Caller is a neighbour, shouting heard, no weapons reported.

Script.Line: It is the house at the end, with the trailer outside it.
Shouting for an hour and then nothing. That is the part that worries me.
The lights are on and nobody is answering the door.

Lines.Approach: The neighbour called it in. Shouting, no weapons mentioned, and no answer from the house.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
